I am definitely biased in this review due to coming here whilst they have the £5 ramen deal, however I have tried to keep that in mind when assessing the quality for the price. I was here on a Thursday at 6.30pm and there was a large queue out the door, though it was moving relatively quickly. I had a reservation and was able to skip the queue so I’d recommend making one for this busy time (by 7.30pm when we left there was a small queue consisting of two(?) large groups). Despite how busy it was staff were still upbeat, and friendly (young, light-haired guy particularly), and we did not have to wait long for our food, or to be approached to order or pay; there was nothing i’d improve in terms of service here. I had the chicken ramen and my friend had the spicy (maybe ‘hell’?) ramen, both of which were very good and came in significant portions. I would suggest the chicken ramen over the spicy one because the chicken was very good and I felt the flavour of the broth was richer without the additional spice. I do think there are far too many noodles in comparison to broth and toppings which would be my main complaint for the usual price point (about £15 usually). However, I find this is the case in many manchester ramen spots so I wouldn’t say this would ruin the experience. Drink prices are reasonable, especially for soft drinks. The atmosphere is very nice despite how crowded it is, and I felt there was enough space between tables to feel comfortable and relax. If you have a seat against the window it provides you space to put down your bags/coats on the sofa-esque seating along the window. Overall, I would recommend this place for its speed, friendly service, nice atmosphere and tasty ramen which for manchester ramen is not unusually priced.
